abstract: Pregnancy specific beta 1 glycoprotein (SP1) was measured in plasma from patients with carcinoma of the breast (42 patients), lung (32 patients, and testis (9 patients). Elevated circulating levels of SP1 were detected in one patient from each group.
abstract_ja: 乳がん患者（42例）、肺がん患者（32例）、精巣がん患者（9例）の血漿中の妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク質（SP1）を測定した。SP1の上昇は、各群で1例ずつのみに認められた。
